description: This file declares the MockClient class that extends the Client API for mocking HTTP requests, along with its associated options and imported dependencies.

classes.name: MockClient
classes.description: A class extending Client to enable request mocking, intercepting, dispatching, and cleanup functionalities.

methods.name: constructor (origin: string, options: MockClient.Options) constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of MockClient with specified origin and options.

methods.name: intercept
methods.description: Sets up request interception matching provided options.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches a mocked request with specified options and handlers.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the mock client, ensuring all queued requests complete before shutdown.

methods.name: cleanMocks
methods.description: Removes all configured mocks from the client.

ctags.name: MockClient
ctags.pattern: /^declare class MockClient extends Client implements Interceptable {$/
